explanation: Disney was cremated after his death in December 1966. The first person to be cryonically preserved, James Bedford, was frozen weeks later, in January 1967. His ashes rest at Forest Lawn in Glendale, California.

claims.text: Walt Disney was cremated after his death in December 1966, so his body was never cryogenically frozen.
James Bedford, frozen in January 1967, was the first person to be cryonically preserved.
Walt Disney's ashes are interred at Forest Lawn Memorial Park in Glendale, California.
